Big news! HYPERSCALE made the longlist for the FT/Standard Chartered Business Book of the Year Award.

They call it a “a polemical on-the-ground investigation into the rapid spread of data centres and their impact on the environment and the communities where Big Tech is building them.”

posts.text:
Carney’s government is *finally* warning Alberta that its healthcare privatization plan would violate the Canada Health Act, specifically the sections on comprehensiveness and accessibility.

Hopefully this is just the beginning. If a province violates the CHA, it’s supposed to face $$$ penalties.
